rounds.title: Pagination baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK paginator: first page, a middle page with two ellipses, last page, few pages without an ellipsis, disabled first/previous and next/last chevrons, the range readout, the sm size, links and the compact pager, plus hover, active and focus-visible on a page item and on the current page. The page-size select is its own component (et-page-size-select, a form field with et-select) and is not drawn here. The current page is a filled button in the brand mint, which is 1.33:1 against the light pane, with no edge: the only mark of the current page fails WCAG 1.4.11 in light (dark 13.50:1). Its focus ring is in the mint as well, 1.37:1 in light. Both variants keep the rest as it is today. Fixed numbers: page text 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; text on the mint fill 15.82:1; ellipsis 7.81:1 light, 6.94:1 dark; disabled chevrons 2.58:1 light, 3.73:1 dark (exempt); hover fill 1.14:1 light, 1.18:1 dark. Hover on the current page changes its fill by 1.03:1 in both schemes, as every filled et-button does; not this round's question. Variant b applies decided rules, not a new call: mint on light rule a (Q99), a mint fill gets an ink edge, and focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid (Q88). Pane edges stay as today (Q98). Variant a shows today for comparison.

a.note: Today: the current page is a bare mint fill, 1.33:1 against the light pane (dark 13.50:1). Focus ring on the current page in mint, 1.37:1 light, 13.06:1 dark; on a page item in the surface primary, 10.37:1 light, 13.07:1 dark.

b.note: Pick. Decided rule Q99 and Q88, not a new call: the current page keeps the mint fill and gets a 1px inset ink edge, 5.48:1 against the light pane and 4.13:1 against the fill; in dark the ink is the mint, so the fill alone carries it at 13.50:1. Every item's focus ring is in --et-theme-color-ink-solid: on the current page 7.68:1 light, 13.50:1 dark; on a page item 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark.
